toml:
# Two-way satellite time and frequency transfer (TWSTFT) between two ILLUSTRATIVE stations, one
# in central Europe and one in eastern North America, through a geostationary relay at 10 deg W.
# The run solves the two-way equation for T_A - T_B from the stated equipment, transponder,
# ionospheric (Ku band, 14/11 GHz) and Sagnac terms. It forms an uncertainty budget whose
# statistical term is the TDEV, at one day, of a simulated link with white and flicker phase
# noise and a diurnal non-reciprocity. The delays and uncertainties are illustrative, not any
# laboratory's calibration. MODELLED. A real UTC-UTC(k) or station-clock series can be added
# under [[series]] (format circular-t, mjd-csv or rinex-clock) to report its stability.
kind = "time-transfer-budget"
satellite_lon_deg = -10.0
transponder_ab_ns = 812.0
transponder_ba_ns = 809.5
uplink_ghz = 14.0
downlink_ghz = 11.0
true_offset_ns = 12.5
white_noise_ns = 0.3
flicker_noise_ns = 0.05
diurnal_amplitude_ns = 0.2
reciprocity_bias_ns = 0.0
step_s = 300.0
span_days = 30.0
averaging_s = 86400.0
seed = 2026

[station_a]
name = "europe"
lat_deg = 50.0
lon_deg = 10.0
height_m = 100.0
tx_delay_ns = 412.3
rx_delay_ns = 398.7
slant_tec_tecu = 30.0

[station_b]
name = "north-america"
lat_deg = 39.0
lon_deg = -77.0
height_m = 50.0
tx_delay_ns = 501.9
rx_delay_ns = 455.2
slant_tec_tecu = 20.0

[uncertainty]
station_calibration_ns = 1.0
equipment_instability_ns = 0.3
transponder_ns = 0.3
ionosphere_ns = 0.02
sagnac_ns = 0.01
